node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double x=0 quintic reduction
node.statement: On the exceptional x=dU-3=0 branch, the reduced fifth equation and h=7 conic exclude d=-2,-3/2,-3 by the official norm-color condition and force every remaining packet onto P_5(d)=60d^5+407d^4+1147d^3+1659d^2+1218d+360=0 with q=-12(5d^3+16d^2+18d+10)/(35(d+2)).
node.notes: Exact necessary finite endpoint only. The 32 official norm gcds are not yet evaluated, and any retained quintic root still owes the other coefficient, color, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner conditions.
